snippet.title: "Watch Out For Goblins!" Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887920/Watch_Out_For_Goblins/

Experience the joy of physics based goblins in their natural habitat. Run, jump, kick and flip your way through a delightful physics sandbox. There's no saying what might happen, and no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY
